---
title: "IPC protocol documentation"
description: "JackMoebius IPC protocol reference: the JSON socket API a front-end like JackMate uses to drive routing, exposure and live status."
---

`jackmoebiusd` exposes a small JSON protocol over a local Unix-domain socket. It's the
same contract the `jackmoebius` CLI and the [JackMate](https://jackmate.app) GUI use, so you can drive JackMoebius
from any language that can open a socket.

## Transport

- **Socket**: `/tmp/jackmoebius.sock`, mode `0600` (owner only).
- **Request / response**: send one JSON line, read one JSON line, the connection closes:

```json
→ {"command":"status"}
← {"status":"ok","data":{ … }}
```

Every reply is `{"status":"ok","data":…}` or `{"status":"error","message":"…"}`. An error may
carry an optional **`code`**, a machine-readable marker (e.g. `"licensing"` when a routing
command is refused because the trial has expired), so a client can react to a class of error
without parsing `message`.

- **Event stream**: a `subscribe` connection stays **open** and streams invalidation
  events (see [Event stream](#event-stream)).

## Health: `status`

```json
→ {"command":"status"}
← {"status":"ok","data":{
     "version":"1.1.0","device_acquired":true,"jack_connected":true,
     "exposed_out":2,"exposed_in":1,"uptime_s":1234,
     "bridge":"shm","shared_input":{"on":true,"apps":["Safari"]},
     "capacity":{"forward":{"used":6,"total":254,"held":0},"reverse":{"used":2,"total":254,"held":0}},
     "default_input_is_jackmoebius":true,
     "licensing":{"state":"trial","days_remaining":9}, … }}
```

Always present: `version`, `device_acquired`, `jack_connected`, `exposed_out`, `exposed_in`, `uptime_s`,
`bridge`, `capacity`, `licensing`. `version` is the installed JackMoebius version (handy for an "About" box, and it
answers even before the audio device is acquired).

- `bridge` is `shm` once the shared-memory transport between the driver and the daemon is up, or `waiting`, with a
  structured `transport_problem` that says why (service not installed, switched off, unreachable, version mismatch,
  slot busy, driver not attached).
- `shared_input` says whether the ports `shared_input_1/2` exist and which apps share them.
- `capacity` is how full the two buses are, in channels (254 usable each way, shared by all apps). `held` says how many of the used
  channels are held by a stream that a card kept after its side was dropped, and `held_by` which apps (see `jack_rebuild`).
- `default_input_is_jackmoebius` tells whether apps without a device menu reach the shared input.
- `licensing` carries `{state, days_remaining}` (state ∈ `trial | licensed | expired`; `days_remaining` is
  present for `trial`/`expired`, absent for `licensed`). Reading or changing the license itself
  (status while stopped, activation) is a **CLI** concern. See the
  [CLI reference](cli.qmd#license-trial); the socket only reports the live state here and
  notifies changes via `licensing_changed`.

## App state: `apps`

Returns one entry per app the driver knows about, both directions in one call:

```json
← {"status":"ok","data":[
     {"name":"Music","key":"com.apple.Music","pid":606,
      "out_exposed":true,"out_backing":"shared","out_channels":[2,3],
      "in_exposed":false,"in_backing":"shared","in_channels":[],
      "can_capture":false,"blacklisted":false}, … ]}
```

- `key`: bundle ID (stable persistence key) · `name`: display name · `pid`.
- `out_exposed` / `in_exposed`: whether the box is exposed (the state `add` set), per direction.
- `out_backing` / `in_backing`: `shared` (the common `JackMoebius` device) or `private` (a **card**: a virtual device of its own,
  named `JackMoebius for <App>`).
- `out_channels` / `in_channels`: the **reserved** bus channels (persistent), or `[]`. For a shared output
  it is the stereo pair; for a shared input there is nothing to reserve.
- `can_capture`: the app can be routed on the input side.
- `blacklisted`: hidden from routing selectors.

## Expose & hide

Each direction has a **backing**, `shared` or `private`, and always send it explicitly.

| Command | Effect | Reply |
|---|---|---|
| `{"command":"jack_add","app":"<key>","backing":"shared"}` | expose the output as a stereo pair of the shared device | `{name,key,backing,channel_offset}` |
| `{"command":"jack_add","app":"<key>","backing":"private","n":8}` | expose the output as a card of `n` channels (1 to 64, default 2) | `{name,key,backing,channels, …}` |
| `{"command":"jack_add_in","app":"<key>","backing":"shared"}` | expose the input as the shared input | `{name,key,backing,channels}` |
| `{"command":"jack_add_in","app":"<key>","backing":"private","n":2}` | expose the input as a card of `n` channels (1 to 64, default 2) | `{name,key,backing,channels, …}` |
| `{"command":"jack_apply","app":"<key>","in":{…},"out":{…}}` | set both directions in one call (each `{backing, n}`; a missing side stays as it is) | `{name,key,in,out}` |
| `{"command":"jack_rebuild","app":"<key>"}` | rebuild the app's card as it is and free the channels a dead stream holds (nothing held: nothing happens) | `{name,key,released,rebuilt, …}` |
| `{"command":"jack_remove","app":"<key>"}` / `jack_remove_in` | hide the output / the input (reservation kept) | `null` |
| `{"command":"jack_clear_assignment","app":"<key>"}` / `jack_clear_in` | drop the reservation | `null` |

`jack_add {app}` with no `backing` and no `n` is the 1.0 form: the stereo stem. `{app, n}` without `backing` is an
error. `jack_add_in` without `backing` means `private`. Only an explicit `backing:"shared"` ever takes a card away.

**Changing the backing of a direction is one call.** A card only holds the directions that are private, so the
effect on the device the app sees is:

| Call | The other direction has a card | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `shared` → `private` | yes | the card is **rebuilt** with this side added: the app sees its device go and come back |
| `shared` → `private` | no | the card is **created** |
| `private` → `shared` | yes | the card is **kept** as it is: this side is no longer wired, its channels stay reserved until the card is deleted or rebuilt |
| `private` → `shared` | no | the card is **deleted**: an app that had chosen it falls back to another device |
| `private` with another `n` | | the card is **rebuilt** with the new width |

`jack_apply` is all or nothing: everything is checked first, then both sides are applied and the card is created, rebuilt or deleted at most
once. If an app has a single device setting for input and output and you want it on a card, make both directions private
(or leave both shared and let it select `JackMoebius`).

## Listings

- `{"command":"jack_list"}` → exposed **output** boxes (stems and cards), each with `out_status` (+
  `current_device` on a mismatch).
- `{"command":"jack_list_in"}` → exposed **input** cards and apps on the shared input, each with `in_status`.
- `{"command":"jack_assignments"}` / `jack_assignments_in` → the persistent reservations.

## Volume and blacklist

- `{"command":"set_volume","app":"<name>","locked":false,"gain":0.5}` → per-app output
  volume (locked = follows the `JackMoebius` device volume; unlocked = independent linear gain). Reply
  `{app,key,locked,gain}`.
- `{"command":"blacklist_show|blacklist_add|blacklist_remove|blacklist_reset", …}`.

## Doctor

```json
→ {"command":"doctor"}
← {"status":"ok","data":{"messages":[
     {"code":"app_input_mismatch","severity":"warning","app":"REAPER",
      "text":"REAPER does not read its JackMoebius card.",
      "remedy":"In REAPER, choose \"JackMoebius for REAPER\" as the input device."}]}}
```

`messages` is empty when nothing is wrong, errors come before warnings. Each message has a stable **`code`** (localize
from it; `text` and `remedy` are English sentences), a `severity` (`error` | `warning`), the display name of the `app`
when the message is about one, a `text` and a `remedy`. The CLI prints the same list
([`jackmoebius doctor`](cli.qmd#doctor), `--json` for this object).

## Errors

An error reply carries a stable **`code`** and, when it helps, a **`details`** object. Show the English `message` as a fallback and
translate from the `code`:

```json
← {"status":"error","message":"not enough free forward channels (need 16, 4 free)","code":"capacity_forward_full",
   "details":{"needed":16,"free":4,"held":0,"largest_holders":[{"app":"REAPER","key":"com.cockos.reaper","channels":64,"dead":0}]}}
```

| `code` | When |
|---|---|
| `jack_not_running` | no JACK server |
| `transport_not_ready` | a card is asked while the shared-memory bridge is not up |
| `app_not_running`, `no_audio_context` | no running app matches, or it holds no audio context yet (`details.app`) |
| `not_capture_capable` | an input is asked of an app that cannot capture |
| `app_blacklisted` | the app is on the blacklist |
| `invalid_channel_count` | a width outside 1 to 64 (`details.direction`, `given`, `min`, `max`) |
| `capacity_forward_full`, `capacity_reverse_full` | not enough free channels (`details.needed`, `free`, `held`, `largest_holders`) |
| `slot_exhausted` | no card slot left |
| `jack_port_limit` | JACK refused to register a port (`details.ports_registered`) |
| `backing_required`, `nothing_to_apply` | a malformed `jack_add` or `jack_apply` |
| `card_not_created`, `no_card` | the driver did not create the card, or `jack_rebuild` found no card |
| `licensing` | the trial has expired |

## Event stream {#event-stream}

Send `{"command":"subscribe"}` on a dedicated connection. The daemon keeps it open and
streams one event line per change (**invalidations**, never full state):

```json
→ {"command":"subscribe"}
← {"event":"exposure_changed"}         # a box was added/removed (out or in)
← {"event":"apps_changed"}             # app launched/quit, capture-capability, blacklist
← {"event":"routing_changed"}          # an app's device usage may have changed
← {"event":"shared_input_changed"}     # an app entered or left the shared input, or its ports came or went
← {"event":"transport_changed"}        # the shared-memory transport came up, or its problem changed
← {"event":"jack_changed"}             # JACK came up / went down
← {"event":"licensing_changed"}        # trial/license state changed (day count, activation, revoke)
← {"event":"stopping"}                 # clean shutdown, just before the socket closes
```

On each event, **re-fetch the matching query** (single source of truth). Ordering matters:
`subscribe` **then** your first fetch, so nothing slips through the gap.

**Liveness is free**: while the connection is open, the daemon is alive. An `EOF`
preceded by `stopping` = a clean stop; a **bare EOF** = a crash.

## Routing status {#routing-status}

`jack_list` / `jack_list_in` report, per box, whether the app actually uses the right
JackMoebius device:

| value | meaning |
|---|---|
| `ok` | the app reads/writes the right JackMoebius device |
| `mismatch` | the app uses **another** device (also returns `current_device` + `current_device_uid`) |
| `idle` | the app uses no device of that direction yet |
| `absent` | the app is not running |

The colour is the front-end's choice: a GUI shows a green / red / amber indicator, and
raises an alert only for boxes it knows are wired.
